item.title: Incomplete weed clearance and leftover debris, 30th August
item.description:
Your road cleaning department came out to clear weeds on our street as part of the council's routine maintenance schedule. However, they only completed the left side of the road and failed to finish the right-hand side.The weeds on the right side are still completely exposed. Furthermore, on the section they did scrape, they left all the rubbish and loose debris behind on the pathway.It looks awful. The maintenance was not completed properly and has been left half-finished. Please arrange for a crew to return to the street, finish clearing the remaining weeds, and sweep away the leftover debris. Been left like this for several days.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Manton Road, Abbey Wood

item.title: Bicycles on Pavements and lime bikes dumped on Royal Hill Estate, 30th August
item.description:
I am seeing more cycling on pavements in this area. Every day they cycle on Greenwich South Street at the Asda end. Can something be done. I always tell them not to cycle on pavements; these are adults not children. Pedestrians deserve to be safe when using pavements and infrastructure designed for them including disabled people on foot. Cyclists can go on roads. No wonder the number of pedestrian collisions with pedal cycles and other wheelies is rising. Lime bikes are often dumped in Blissett street outside entrance gates on the Royal Hill estate. When reported to Lime it keeps happening. RBG should be fining this company as other Boroughs do for obstructing pedestrian access and nuisance dumping.
Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Blissett Street, Greenwich
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Outside no. 1, 30th August
item.description:
Your terrible fix to the paving slabs that were coming up a. Is not working and b. Has made this trip hazard even more dangerous and permanent. Attempting a budget fix with tarmac rather than identifying the cause of the paving slabs rising was wholly inappropriate and unsightly, not to mention environmentally unsound. Even if it had stopped the slabs from rising further, it was ugly and made the trip hazard permanent. In any case, the slabs have risen further causing a greater trip hazard. Further, the tarmac and the shadow cast make this less visible as you walk, even to those with perfect vision. You need to fix this properly before someone has a bad accident
